*Voices — Whose voice a CLAIM is in, within the record's own deliberation. Not whether the record believes it, which is the status: the two vary independently, and the mismatched pairs are the information (ADR-032).*

**Counter** — put forward on an opponent's behalf, at full strength — a steelman, or an objection anticipated as devil's advocate. A counter that goes Active means the record was persuaded, and the thesis it opposed needs revisiting.

| [CLAIM-999](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-999.md) v2 | A distinction among a self's perspectives cannot disappear as a probe regime is enriched along a nested family: it can disappear only when the regime changes otherwise, by dropping or replacing probes, coarsening what is recorded or shortening the horizon, which are changes of regime under which it is relative and not false, or when the organization itself changes, in which case it was a fact about the earlier organization and is not relative to any regime | [CLAIM-1044](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1044.md) ends: "Distinctions made under one such regime may disappear or reorganize under another without thereby becoming unreal or false." | [CLAIM-1037](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1037.md) v2 | If constructor theory's programme holds, Deutsch and Marletto's possibility facts meet the relata–realization frame's second defeater: being an information medium is an exact property of a substrate fixed by which tasks are possible, every constructor that could perform them is approximate and none need exist, and the laws are themselves statements of possibility that mention no constructor, so an exact individuating constraint is realized by no actual thing, and reading it as modal maintenance concedes that what individuates is the modal fact and not its realizers | Alternative 2 of two for [LEAD-195](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-195.md)'s second question: does a possibility fact in Deutsch and Marletto's sense meet [CLAIM-477](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-477.md)'s definition?
